messages:
Ava: Quick sync — trying to compress a PLG microfunnel for next week's webinar. Idea: seed small credits + tailored prompt templates, run a 3-day nurture, then invite high-engagement users to a live office hours session. Need copy + routing + experiment metrics.
Sam: Love it. What’s the target cohort? new signups last 7 days or returned trial users?
Ava: Primary: new signups in last 7 days with < 3 requests. Secondary: trial users who stalled at first prompt.
Priya: I can sketch 3 email copy variants (friendly, product-first, benchmark-led). Also can do in-product banners. ETA EOD.
Diego: For routing — prefer to use the inbox signal: first 3 requests under threshold -> add to "seed-credit" experiment. Can we flag by plan type? free vs seed credits?
Ava: Yes flag by plan. Free tier gets 20 starter credits, trial/pro accounts get 50. We’ll randomize treatment on credits + prompt template combo.
Jen: Landing creative idea: 2-panel carousel — prompt examples on left, short how-to video on right. I’ll draft assets sized for 600x400 hero and 320x180 mobile.
Sam: Metrics: open rate, click->deploy prompt, first-successful-response (>=1 useful reply), and conversion to weekly retention. Recommend instrumentation: event names: credit_offered, prompt_template_selected, prompt_run_success.
Priya: Draft copy snippet (bench-led):
```
Subject: Try Redwood with a guided prompt — free credits inside
Hey — we loaded 50 starter credits and 3 prompt templates tuned for product copy and customer support. Try one and join our office hours on Wed for pro tips.
```
Diego: Ops note: need to add routing rule in launchboard: if credit_offered=true AND plan=free AND requests<3 then assign cohort=sprout-seed. I’ll drop the rule at 10:00 PST.
ops-bot: deploy-job "launchboard-rule-update" queued by Diego at 10:02 — status: pending
Ava: Experiment arms: A) credits only, B) credits + templates, C) credits + templates + timed nudge (48h). Can we cap to 5k users?
Sam: Yes cap 5k. Suggest stratify by region to avoid timezone issues for office hours. Also set a holdout of 10% to measure baseline.
Jen: Mockups done by noon. Want copy approval before I finalize.
Priya: I'll post the three subject lines and the CTA variations in a doc — want quick A/B on CTA: "Try prompt" vs "Open credits".
Ava: Ops — please confirm routing rule deployed. Diego?
Diego: Rule live at 10:22, ops-bot reports success.
ops-bot: deploy-job "launchboard-rule-update" completed at 10:22 — status: success
Sam: Timeline recap: creative + copy by EOD today, routing live, experiment start Mon 09:00 PST, office hours Wed 16:00 PST. Reporting dashboard set for day+1 cohorts.
Ava: Perfect. After first 48h we’ll evaluate prompt-run conversion and adjust templates if needed. Thanks all :rocket: 
Jen: Adding notes to marketing board.
Priya: Posting copy links now.
Sam: Ping me once dashboard is wired (Slack thread or #growth-alerts).
Ava: Closing with action items: Priya copy, Jen assets, Diego routing, Sam instrumentation, me overseeing rollout.
